description: This file contains media codec parsing functions, codec name mappings, and operator overloads for media metadata output, specifically for video and audio codecs including AV1, H264, H265, VP9, VP8, and others, with support for different API versions.

classes.name: SbMediaMasteringMetadata
classes.description: Structure representing mastering display metadata for media.

classes.name: SbMediaColorMetadata
classes.description: Structure containing color metadata for media streams.

classes.name: SbMediaVideoSampleInfo
classes.description: Structure with information about a video sample, including codec and dimensions.

classes.name: SbMediaAudioSampleInfo
classes.description: Structure with information about an audio sample, including codec and configuration.

classes.name: SbMediaVideoStreamInfo
classes.description: Structure with detailed video stream info, including codec and capabilities.

classes.name: SbMediaAudioStreamInfo
classes.description: Structure with detailed audio stream info, including codec and configuration.

methods.name: ParseAv1Info
methods.description: Parses AV1 codec string to extract profile, level, bit depth, and IDs.

methods.name: ParseH264Info
methods.description: Parses H264 codec string to extract profile and level.

methods.name: ParseH265Info
methods.description: Parses H265 codec string to extract profile and level.

methods.name: ParseVp09Info
methods.description: Parses VP9 codec string to extract profile and bit depth.

methods.name: ParseVp9Info
methods.description: Parses VP9 codec string to extract profile and bit depth.

methods.name: VerifyFormat
methods.description: Checks if a format string matches a reference pattern.

methods.name: VerifyFormatStrictly
methods.description: Checks if a format string exactly matches a reference pattern.
